name: Detect And Annotate Somatic Mutations
description: Detects and annotates somatic mutations in tumor samples compared to matched normal samples using GATK Mutect2 for variant calling, GATK FilterMutectCalls for filtering, and SnpEff for functional anno
detailed_description: Detects and annotates somatic mutations in tumor samples compared to matched normal samples using GATK Mutect2 for variant calling, GATK FilterMutectCalls for filtering, and SnpEff for functional annotation.
when_to_use: When you need detect and annotate somatic mutations analysis

parameters.tumor_bam: [Required] Path to the tumor sample BAM file (str)
parameters.normal_bam: [Required] Path to the matched normal sample BAM file (str)
parameters.reference_genome: [Required] Path to the reference genome FASTA file (str)
parameters.snpeff_database: [Optional] SnpEff database to use for annotation (default: GRCh38.105)
